title: 一对多关联避免重复
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单、实付金额大于0且至少有一条订单明细的订单，返回订单数和订单级实付金额合计；每个订单只计算一次。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: WITH eligible_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.paid_amount FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND o.ordered_at < CAST('2026-08-23' AS TIMESTAMP) AND o.paid_amount > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单数, SUM(paid_amount) AS 实付金额合计 FROM eligible_orders
